message.reasoning_content:
We need to parse the facts and determine crimes. Facts: 

- Wang Mou (defendant) blocked Zhang, then his son Li was slapped by Wang. Then Wang instructed workers to beat Li, causing Li light injury (first-degree). That's intentional injury (故意伤害) causing light injury. So Wang is liable for intentional injury (罪名: 故意伤害罪). Also he instructed others to fabricate false evidence (伪证) and bribed Ren for false testimony, also instructed workers to go to police station to make false testimony. That's "伪证罪" (false testimony) or "组织、强迫他人作伪证罪". Also bribery of a witness? Could be "行贿罪" (bribery) for giving 1万元 monthly to Ren for false testimony. Also "妨害司法公正罪"? In Chinese law, "伪证罪" is for giving false testimony, but also "组织、强迫他人作伪证罪" for ordering others to give false testimony. So Wang's acts: ordering workers to beat Li (intentional injury), ordering Ren to give false testimony (organizing false testimony), and bribing Ren (bribery). Also possibly "滥用职权" not relevant. So multiple crimes.

Thus answer: [罪名]故意伤害罪;组织、强迫他人作伪证罪;行贿罪<eoa>
